title: Glucose Transporters
text: Insulin binds to receptors on cell membranes, causing glucose transport proteins (GLUT4) to move to the cell surface. This allows glucose to enter cells for respiration or storage.

title: Negative Feedback Loop
text: As blood glucose decreases, this is detected by beta cells which then reduce insulin secretion. The response (lowered glucose) inhibits the stimulus (high glucose) - this is negative feedback.
